preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 100 for x in [n, a, b])
preconditions.description: n, a, b are integers where 1 ≤ n ≤ 100 and 0 ≤ a, b ≤ 15
The number of grooms n must be strictly greater than the sum of 'Oh...' (a) and 'Wow!' (b) counts

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (all(isinstance(t, int) and 1 <= t <= 50000 for t in sequence) and len(sequence) == n)
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence exists, output n integers between 1 and 50000; otherwise output -1

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(sequence) == n and oh_count(sequence) == a and wow_count(sequence) == b)
postconditions.description: The output sequence must produce exactly a 'Oh...' and b 'Wow!' counts
